0022600030.text: Milwaukee hosts Toronto in the Bucks' ninth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Bucks at 1-7 on a four-game losing streak and sitting 15th in the East, while the Raptors are 4-4 and 5th in the East after a loss in their last game. Milwaukee is without Kam Jones, who is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision, while Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), and Immanuel Quickley (hamstring), Jakob Poeltl (shoulder), Kyle Anderson (illness), and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) are all day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season the Bucks lost the series 1-3, including a 122-94 loss to Toronto in Milwaukee on February 22, 2026.
